description: Writes and reviews phased, executable, verifiable, reviewable, rollback-aware software engineering plans with plan-to-code completeness, benefit validation, and chain-state logging evidence for implementation, refactor, migration, rollout, bug-fix, performance, security, and DevOps work.

changes: Require plans to include chain-state logging design for affected runtime, release, data, job, API, user, or operator flows.
Add logging matrices that capture key states, success signals, failure signals, failure reason fields, correlation fields, log levels, and consumers.
Extend validation fixtures, the full-plan exemplar, and sanity checks to verify logging observability evidence.
Document safe logging guardrails for sensitive data, cardinality, sampling, retention, dashboards, alerts, and runbooks.
